note: Alberta Parks campground in five loops (A-E) on the south side of the Elkwater townsite, in open mixed forest; walking trails lead to Elkwater Lake's beach and marina. Driveways run 20-50 ft; 8 sites are under 23 ft. Water and the campground showers are shut off for the winter; year-round showers, flush toilets and drinking water are at the Lakeview shower house by the registration booth. Firewood is sold in the townsite. --Claude
